class_name: 逆接-想外-ニモカカワラズ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: in spite of the fact that …
patterns.usage_note: Reports that a circumstance failed to produce the outcome it should have, with surprise or reproach (大雨にもかかわらず、長い列ができていた); the formal written counterpart of のに. Its classmate をよそに says someone deliberately brushed the circumstance aside; にもかかわらず only says the expected effect did not follow. A bare noun, a plain verb, an i-adjective and た attach directly; a na-adjective or predicative noun takes である (危険であるにもかかわらず).

examples.ruby: 大雨[おおあめ]にもかかわらず、会場[かいじょう]には長[なが]い列[れつ]ができていた。
examples.english: Despite the downpour, a long line had formed outside the venue.

examples.ruby: 何度[なんど]も注意[ちゅうい]したにもかかわらず、弟[おとうと]は同[おな]じ失敗[しっぱい]を繰[く]り返[かえ]した。
examples.english: Even though I warned him time and again, my brother made the very same mistake.

examples.ruby: 医者[いしゃ]に止[と]められているにもかかわらず、父[ちち]は煙草[たばこ]をやめない。
examples.english: My father's doctor has told him to stop, and yet he still won't give up cigarettes.

patterns.usage_note: The subject pushes aside someone else's 心配, 反対, 批判, or 期待 and goes ahead anyway (住民の反対をよそに、工事は進められた), usually with a shade of disapproval. Its classmate にもかかわらず only reports that a circumstance failed to have its expected effect, without that deliberate disregard. Written style; it attaches to a noun, and to a clause only through の (騒いでいるのをよそに).

examples.ruby: 周囲[しゅうい]の心配[しんぱい]をよそに、祖父[そふ]は単身[たんしん]で山[やま]へ向[む]かった。
examples.english: Heedless of everyone's concern, my grandfather set off for the mountains alone.

examples.ruby: 住民[じゅうみん]の反対[はんたい]をよそに、工事[こうじ]は着々[ちゃくちゃく]と進[すす]められた。
examples.english: In defiance of the residents' objections, the construction pushed steadily ahead.

examples.ruby: 弟[おとうと]は家族[かぞく]の落胆[らくたん]をよそに、大学[だいがく]をやめて店[みせ]を開[ひら]いた。
examples.english: Paying no attention to his family's dismay, my brother quit university and opened a shop.
